extracted.intended_audience: USPTO PAIR users, patent practitioners, applicants, and staff handling international design (Hague) applications
extracted.subtask_short: searching Hague design applications in PAIR
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for locating and viewing international design (Hague) applications and related data in the USPTO PAIR system, including how identifiers map, which PAIR tabs show Hague data, and conditions when data is available. Includes notes about publication, designation of the United States, and support.

rubrics_metrics.name: International registration number format (WIPO)
rubrics_metrics.description: An international design application satisfying the requirements under the Hague Agreement for international registration will be assigned an international registration number by WIPO, which begins with the series code “DM/nnnnnn”.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to identify the published WIPO international registration (DM/ number) and can be searched in PAIR (see International Design Registration Number search).

rubrics_metrics.name: USPTO 35-series application number for Hague applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Published international design applications designating the United States are assigned an application number by the USPTO beginning with the series code “35/nnn,nnn”.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PAIR users can search for a 35-series application by using the “Application Number” search under the “Search for Application” section in PAIR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search by Application Number in PAIR
rubrics_metrics.description: PAIR users can search for a 35-series application by using the “Application Number” search found under the “Search for Application” section in PAIR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search by International Design Registration Number (DM/number) in PAIR
rubrics_metrics.description: PAIR users can search for a 35-series application corresponding to a published international design application designating the United States by the international registration number using the “International Design Registration Number” search found under the “Search for Application” section in PAIR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This search requires that the international design application has been published by WIPO and (implicitly) designated the United States.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data availability contingent on Geneva Act taking effect
rubrics_metrics.description: Any data associated with international design applications will not be available in PAIR until after the Geneva Act of the Hague Agreement has taken effect with respect to the United States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attempting to search for international design applications or data associated with these applications prior to that date will accordingly result in an error message being displayed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement: designation of the United States and WIPO publication for PAIR visibility
rubrics_metrics.description: If the international design application has not designated the United States or has not been published by WIPO, searching for the corresponding 35-series application based on the international registration number (DM/ number) will not be available in PAIR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the application both designates the U.S. and is published by WIPO before expecting DM-based search results in PAIR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Data tab: new Hague data elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Once a PAIR user successfully searches an international design application, the user may note new types of information corresponding to international design applications on the Application Data tab, namely the 35-series application number and two new data elements: (1) International Registration Number (Hague) and (2) International Registration Publication Date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These fields appear on the Application Data tab for Hague-designated records in PAIR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Display hyphen when WIPO-assigned data not yet available
rubrics_metrics.description: If these two data elements have not yet been assigned by WIPO, a hyphen will be displayed to illustrate that the data is not available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hyphen acts as a placeholder indicating WIPO has not yet provided the International Registration Number or Publication Date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Published Documents tab availability and Hague Express link
rubrics_metrics.description: Once the international design application has been published by WIPO, the Published Documents tab will become available in PAIR and users will be able to link to the Hague Express database and view additional contents and details of the WIPO publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Published Documents tab is only present after WIPO publication; it provides direct linkage to WIPO publication details via Hague Express.

rubrics_metrics.name: Where to find more information about the Hague system
rubrics_metrics.description: Information concerning the Hague system, including geographic coverage and a guide for users, is available at WIPO’s Web site http://www.wipo.int/hague/en/.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult WIPO’s Hague pages for system-wide information and user guidance beyond PAIR-specific instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PAIR technical support availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Full technical support for PAIR is available 6 AM to Midnight Eastern Time, Monday – Friday, through the Patent Electronic Business Center (EBC) at 866-217-9197 or by e-mail at ebc@uspto.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact EBC for technical problems searching or viewing Hague-related data in PAIR during stated hours.
